raw.query: SELECT experiment, lead_s, MAX(CASE WHEN policy='forecast' THEN p99_ms END) as forecast_p99, MAX(CASE WHEN policy='reactive' THEN p99_ms END) as reactive_p99, ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN policy='forecast' THEN p99_ms END)-MAX(CASE WHEN policy='reactive' THEN p99_ms END)) as p99_diff_ms FROM v_pool_latency WHERE is_current AND pool='both' AND window_name='steady24h' AND policy IN ('forecast','reactive') AND experiment='a2' GROUP BY experiment, lead_s ORDER BY lead_s;
raw.observed: steady24h p99: forecast 677.365 vs reactive 548.363–733.643 (diff up to 129 ms); p50=0 and p90=52.255 identical
raw.claimed: steady-head percentiles identical to three decimals
raw.evidence: p50 (0) and p90 (52.255) match across policies; p99 diverges by 4.7–129 ms and max by 1.6 s even at steady24h (experiment a2). Burst windows (e.g. burst3 lead_s=30) show p99 588 vs 16,079 ms — burst divergence is real.
raw.fix: Recast as 'p50 and p90 are identical under low load; p99 diverges modestly (≤130 ms) while burst p99 divergence is orders of magnitude larger' or limit claim to p50/p90.
